category: hosted bot (Telegram file to link, 24-hour links)

free_tier.stated: The page offers a file-to-link bot whose links expire after 24 hours; no price, quota or daily count is stated.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: the bot's page states no per-file cap; Telegram's own file ceiling is 2 GB (4 GB with Premium).

retention.stated: 'The Generated Link will expire after 24 Hrs.'

egress.terms: No traffic allowance or price is stated on the bot's page.

interface_detail: A Telegram chat with the bot; the result is a link or a file delivered into the chat. No HTTP API is published.
tooling: Any Telegram client; a Telegram account is required to start the bot.
chaining: Links last one day, so it serves a same-day pull only; the stored Telegram file itself is not stated to expire.

limits.value: 1 day: the link expires after 24 hours

binding_note: The only stated number is the 24-hour link life.

identity_cost.detail: A Telegram account, which is logged in with a mobile phone number; no key or card is asked on the bot's page.

reliability_note: Support is through the group @HeimanSupport and the channel @HeimanSupports.
confidence_note: The description is the bot's own, read on its t.me page. Liveness of the backend needs a Telegram account and was not tested. Any paid tier of the bot is unverified: behind a sign-up (it is reached from inside the bot, with a Telegram account); the bot's page states no price.
